sources: OBJ Razorhorn, skill 3: rmxlinux Json/SkillData sk_wpn_lance_0013 (game 1.6). Its `buffs` give the wielder buff_wpn_lance_0013_damage01 for the whole fight (lifeType 1): damageModifier with CheckTagMatch on the target for tags 1570888476 (Cryo Infliction, buff_common_energy_shard_attached_cryst) or 1535684437 (Solidification, buff_common_cryst_*_triggered), DamageScaleProcessor NormalCalcZone +dmg_up. passiveEventActions abilityEvent 208 (the wielder consumes a buff): CheckBuffIdInContext tag 1535684437 (Solidification), CheckConsumeBuffLayer ≥ 1 → CreateBuff buff_wpn_lance_0013_atk_up on the wielder (attributeType 2 formulaItem 6: ATK +atk_up, duration `duration`, stackingType 2 max 1). SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_lance_0013 L9: dmg_up 0.224, atk_up 0.336, duration 15. Batch-3 report docs/kit-batches/batch-3/chr_0012_avywen.md rows 35–36.

The DMG bonus's condition is judged on the enemy as the damage is computed, after the hit's own applications (batch-3 C1), as the data checks the target's tags at the DamageAction: the hit that Solidifies gets it, the hit that Shatters doesn't. Whether a Shatter counts as consuming Solidification is open (A7, in-game test 63): here yes (the shatter trigger). Physical DMG and Will lines are stat-panel modifiers; toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01 has no BuffData file (inert). Not in any log or fixture yet.
